fire: The patient was treated for Hodgkin disease last spring.
Yellow catkins covered the hazel by the gate.
Our new neighbour, Mr Aitkin, grows roses.
The poems of Pushkin are taught in every school.
In March the birch catkins release their pollen.
Thomas Hodgkin described the illness in 1832.
The garden of the Aitkin family is open on Sundays.
A statue of Pushkin stands in the square.
quiet: The patient was treated for lung disease last spring.
Yellow flowers covered the hazel by the gate.
Our new neighbour, Mr Archer, grows roses.
The poems of Tolstoy are taught in every school.
In March the birch trees release their pollen.
Thomas Addison described the illness in 1855.
The garden of the Archer family is open on Sundays.
A statue of Lermontov stands in the square.
